headline: Intel job posting seeks mixed-signal verification leadership for PLL and FLL clock IP
fact: Intel posted a Senior Pre-Silicon Verification Engineer role describing functional verification of PLL and FLL clock-generator IP, SystemVerilog/UVM environments, tests, assertions and coverage, and leadership of mixed-signal validation using AMS simulations to identify and root-cause schematic bugs. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate for clock-IP verification, not proof of the completion or deployment of a particular verification flow.

sources.title: Intel Careers: Senior Pre-Silicon Verification Engineer (JR0280545)
sources.summary: The indexed official Intel requisition described the PLL/FLL, UVM/SystemVerilog, assertion, coverage, AMS-simulation, and schematic-debug mandate; the requisition is no longer active.
